product_metadata.title: Rustic Wooden Serving Tray for Ottoman and Coffee Table Lap Tray (16.3L x 12.2W x 2H in, Multicolor)
features: ✅ ALL NATURAL. HAND PAINTED. MADE RESPONSIBLY – Every tray is hand painted, made of quality, durable wood, from responsible supplier certified by Forest Stewardship Council.

✅ STYLISH AND MULTI-PURPOSE – Slightly distressed surface. Natural rustic yet clean and crisp looking. Works well with almost any home decor from farmhouse to modern chic. STURDY yet LIGHTWEIGHT. Allows you to carry food and drinks with ease, ideal for serving food and drinks, breakfast in bed, for ottoman, perfect as a lap tray or an organizer for magazines, accessories. Makes a wonderful gift for any occasion!

✅ DIMENSION – DO TAKE NOTE: Outer dimension: 16.3 L x 12.2 W x 2 H. Inner dimension: 15.45L x 11.2 W x 1.7 H. We want to make sure you get the right size that serves all your needs; all our photos are real photos without photoshop to alter the size of any objects for optical illusion. However, it would be best that you measure your ottoman or plates, objects you wish to use this tray for, before you place your order.

✅ NO LEAK BUT NOT FULL SPILL-PROOF – Base of the tray is made of one whole piece to prevent liquid spill from leaking through. To best preserve the rustic look, coating for the tray surface is applied sparingly, and invisible. It provides some, but not full, protection against staining (more in “Product Description”). Though not an official recommendation from us, some customers said for added protection, they applied another light coat of polyurethane to our trays, which still ‘look great’.

✅ ANY ISSUES? WE ARE HERE TO HELP - We know our customers love these trays. However, we also noticed that from time to time, some of these hand-crafted and hand-finished products with imperfections and defects escaped quality check, e.g. paint spill, rough edges, etc. If you are not satisfied with our product for any reason, please contact us right away. We want to do our best to address every issue to your satisfaction or give you a full refund. Your satisfaction is paramount to us.
description: Rustic Wooden Serving Trays have been thoughtfully designed and carefully hand-painted to help you serve food and drinks in style. Rustic and chic, these versatile and most Pinterest worthy wood serving trays bring a whole new vibe to your tabletop, ottoman, sofa or coffee table for wedding, birthday, holidays, party, Christmas and all other occasion.

Wipe surface after use with a damp cloth or paper towel. Any spill must be wiped off within a few minutes or if necessary, rinsed off under running water (for no more than 30 seconds), and wiped dry immediately. Do not use any detergent. Do not soak in water and never put it in a dishwasher.

Each product is made of natural wood and handcrafted. The wood grain, stain, surface treatment may vary slightly. Color in the photo may also vary from the actual wood due to individual computer monitor with variable color & resolution.
